cases.prompt: Forty enquiries came in this week from the website form. Which ones do we actually call?
expect: confirms the ICP and the weights are written before scoring
checks disqualifiers before computing any score
scores every lead on the same rubric with evidence per factor
returns A-band leads first with an owner and a first-touch deadline
logs the declines with codes and names the one thing that would raise the batch
must_not: fill in a missing employee count
cases.pass: a scorecard with bands, reasons, owners and deadlines, plus a coded decline log

expect: asks for the lead record itself and the ICP, in one message
explains that a score needs an ICP to score against
offers to draft a first ICP from the last twenty deals if none exists
must_not: give a verdict on a lead it has not seen
cases.pass: one consolidated request, a stated method, and no invented verdict

cases.prompt: Score the leads in our HubSpot pipeline.
expect: names the CRM as not reachable and says what it blocks: history, owner, existing relationships
asks for a CSV export with the required fields and the arrival timestamps
scores from the export and marks CRM history as unverified in the output
must_not: claim to have read the pipeline
cases.pass: the limitation stated first, an exact export request, and unverified items flagged

cases.prompt: Write a follow-up email sequence for the A-band leads.
expect: declines the sequence and routes to sales-outreach
supplies the handover packet: band, reasons, verbatim enquiry, the three questions
cases.pass: clean handoff with the qualification context the writer needs

cases.prompt: This lead is an existing customer asking about a second product. Score it.
expect: detects the existing-customer disqualifier and returns ALREADY-SERVED
routes to customer success rather than the sales queue
still supplies the enquiry text and the reason it is an expansion conversation
must_not: score it as a new lead
send it to the sales round-robin
cases.pass: correct code, correct route, and the expansion context preserved
